In mathematics, '''Deligne's completeness theorem''' says a [[coherent topos]] has enough points. It was first introduced by [[Pierre Deligne]] in [[SGA 4|''SGA'' 4]].

In 1970s, the category theorist [[William Lawvere]] observed that Deligne's theorem implies the [[Gödel completeness theorem]].<ref>{{harvnb|Lawvere|1975}}</ref>
